fa-01.note: Supported supinated barbell wrist flexion. Our 139 is kneeling with forearms on a flat bench (variants/forearm.ts:123); the package's is seated. Same joint action, grip and support; posture is not a dimension our 139 variant records.

fa-02.note: Supported pronated barbell wrist extension; 140 is kneeling, forearms on a bench (variants/forearm.ts:124).

fa-03.note: No behind-the-back wrist curl in the catalog. 139 is the nearest family (supinated barbell wrist flexion) but is supported in front of the body; a behind-the-back row would be a new catalog row (one variant per catalog id, 10-multi-region.md:279).

fa-04.note: Barbell, palms down, wrist held straight (variants/forearm.ts:110).

fa-05.note: No reverse (pronated) preacher curl. 126 Preacher Curl is supinated (variants/forearm.ts:101); 135 Reverse Curl is not on a pad.

fa-06.note: No barbell static hold. 145 Farmer Hold is 'an implement in each hand', neutral grip (variants/forearm.ts:152); a bar held in both hands, pronated or mixed, is a different grip and forearm orientation.

fa-07.note: Package blocks it (protocol unknown). Candidates: 238 Barbell Rollout (abdominal), 141 Wrist Roller, 401 Finger Curl (bar rolled to the fingertips). Do not choose; keep blocked.

fa-08.note: Base exercise is 121 Barbell Curl (supinated, straight bar, variants/forearm.ts:96). The thick handle cannot be recorded: no grip-diameter value in GripType (types.ts:278-280) or in the descriptive dimensions (variants/dimensions.ts:86-95), and only one current variant per catalog id. Mapping as 121 means thick-grip sets are read as plain barbell curls.

fa-09.note: Barbell Romanian deadlift exists twice in the catalog (42, 186; 05-mappings.md:272), both mapped identically; thick handle not recordable (as fa-08).

fa-10.note: Package blocks it. Candidates: 140 Reverse Wrist Curl, 401 Finger Curl, 141 Wrist Roller, 415 Wrist Roller, Extension Wind.

fa-11.note: One-Arm Dumbbell Wrist Curl, forearm on the thigh, palm up (variants/forearm.ts:130). The package does not say one dumbbell or two; ours is one-arm (unilateral, sidedBy arm).

fa-13.note: Package blocks it (wrist flexion or radial deviation not identified). If it is radial deviation, 407 Lever Radial Deviation; if neutral-forearm wrist flexion, the catalog has none.

fa-15.note: No preacher hammer curl. 132 is unsupported; 126 is supinated.

fa-16.note: Zottman Curl: up palms up, down palms down (variants/forearm.ts:111).

fa-17.note: Lever Pronation: forearm supported, elbow ~90 deg, handle loaded at one end, turns palm-down (variants/forearm.ts:136). Matches the package's corrected direction and its offset-lever requirement.

fa-19.note: Lever Radial Deviation, arm straight at the side, weight in front (variants/forearm.ts:132): the resistance vector the package asks to confirm is defined.

fa-21.note: Base exercise 299 Farmer's Walk (an implement in each hand, walking, time recorded; variants/forearm.ts:153). Thick handle not recordable (as fa-08).

fa-22.note: Package alias of fa-12. By name it is exactly 411 One-Arm Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl; one catalog row, no second record or dose.

fa-23.note: No cable wrist curl (flexion). The catalog has only the extension, 350.

fa-24.note: Cable Wrist Extension, palms down against a low pulley (variants/forearm.ts:129); our variant leaves bar/handle and forearm support unknown, the package says supported.

fa-25.note: No cable reverse curl. 135 is a barbell.

fa-26.note: Two catalog rows describe a rope hammer curl on a low pulley: 134 Rope Hammer Curl and 337 Rope Hammer Cable Curl (variants/forearm.ts:109, 115). Both mapped identically (neutralCurl, mappings.ts:238).

fa-27.note: Package blocks it (elbow or wrist family). If an elbow curl with the arm behind the torso, 129 Bayesian Cable Curl; no behind-the-back cable wrist curl exists.

fa-29.note: No towel cable row. 78 Towel Pull-Up is the only towel pull.

fa-30.note: No pronation machine; 405 is a dumbbell lever (equipment Dumbbells).

fa-31.note: No supination machine; 406 is a dumbbell lever.

fa-33.note: Suitcase Carry: one dumbbell or kettlebell in one hand, walking (variants/forearm.ts:154).

fa-35.note: No bottoms-up clean. 387 Kettlebell Clean is an ordinary clean and is deliberately unmapped (unmapped.ts:34, 'Ballistic: the bell rotates around the hand').

fa-36.note: No kettlebell hammer curl; 132 is 'two dumbbells'.

fa-38.note: Plate Pinch, two smooth plates, one hand (variants/forearm.ts:149).

fa-39.note: No plate flip; package blocks it.

fa-40.note: No plate wrist curl; package blocks it.

fa-41.note: Dead Hang, both hands, palms forward (variants/forearm.ts:150).

fa-44.note: Base exercise 143 Dead Hang; thick bar not recordable (as fa-08).

fa-45.note: No fingertip push-up; 26 Standard Push-Up is on the palms.

fa-47.note: Gripper Close, torsion-spring gripper closed and opened (variants/forearm.ts:141).

fa-48.note: No ball squeeze. 402/403 are a torsion-spring gripper.

fa-50-finger-close.note: No rice-bucket drills in the catalog.

fa-50-finger-open.note: No rice bucket; 404 Band Finger Extension is the nearest family (same action).
